text:
Proteas’ remaining T20 World Cup fixtures and start times
The Super 8 is on the horizon.
The Proteas have their Super 8 qualification hopes in their own hands at the T20 World Cup after a dramatic win over Afghanistan.
Here’s what’s on the horizon for South Africa at the showpiece in India and Sri Lanka.
Proteas T20 World Cup fixtures
- Fri, 14 Feb: New Zealand vs South Africa, 15:30 start
- Tue, 18 Feb: South Africa vs United Arab Emirates, 07:30 start
The taste of silverware is overdue
The Proteas ended a 26-year trophy drought when they beat Australia in the World Test Championship final at Lord’s in 2025. Aside from giving them a much-needed shot in the arm and silverware for the cabinet, it also silenced a lot of the haters who have given them the ‘chokers’ tag after several failures in big tournaments.
Proteas win a thriller against Afghanistan
We needed not one but TWO sets of super overs to eventually get past Afghanistan in a thriller of a match on Wednesday. That summary doesn’t tell the story, so check out this report from Craig Lewis.
ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026 squad
Aiden Markram (captain, Momentum Multiply Titans), Corbin Bosch (Momentum Multiply Titans), Dewald Brevis (Momentum Multiply Titans), Quinton de Kock (DP World Lions), Tony de Zorzi (World Sports Betting Western Province), Donovan Ferreira (Momentum Multiply Titans), Marco Jansen (Momentum Multiply Titans), George Linde (World Sports Betting Western Province), Keshav Maharaj (Hollywoodbets Dolphins), Kwena Maphaka (DP World Lions), David Miller (Hollywoodbets Dolphins), Lungi Ngidi (Momentum Multiply Titans), Anrich Nortje (Hollywoodbets Dolphins), Kagiso Rabada (DP World Lions) and Jason Smith (Hollywoodbets Dolphins).
